notes.title: DEVLOG#10
notes.content:
[h1]Attention, attention! Devlogs from Farm Renovator are back!😄[/h1][p] [/p][p]It’s true — we’ve been quiet for a while. [/p][p]But now we’re back, and we’re not going anywhere! 😄[/p][p][/p][p]In today’s devlog, we’d like to give you a quick preview of the task system we're working on for the game. [/p][p][/p][p]To kick things off, here are a few gifs showing the renovation of a long-forgotten footbridge — tied to a story that may seem funny at first glance, but ends up being rather tragic. We won’t spoil the details just yet… let’s keep the mystery alive, haha.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/e957f32374aeac8fcfbedf1e96af3901597f52a9.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/afe4412352d1013e990a91f9c470314bfe7bb17d.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/d2b8d5e112c926ac85eda9ffcdcf34f8d949fd4a.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/8b1546243efa3a7b3bc58bcba602acf6c346a38d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As every farmer knows, facing the forces of nature is part of the job. [/p][p]This time, our farm escaped unharmed — but the storm did cause trouble for one of our visitors. [/p][p]Time to jump in and lend a hand! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/ff4de3d0ef6f42391a530746910d347e6764983c.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/2ce47489866f92c57d591fa3aafab92efe0088f7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned — we’ve got a lot more devlogs planned, and they’ll be coming your way more often than before! [/p][p][/p][p]That's all in this devlog. [/p][p]Don't forget to visit our discord and until next time! 😄  [/p][p][/p]

[p]

notes.title: DEVLOG#9
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Farm renovator devlog !😄[/h1]

We are back after the break with fresh news straight from the farm!
In this devlog I would like to show you some more progress.

Let's start with the new building. Player will get a workshop at his disposal. We have already shown you the version to be cleaned up in the past,
today I would like to show you the ready-to-work version. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/9330e147cd78616a9d5c072be08b2106499635fb.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/aa71e77f3939b4ffd19c65d4b4ee8d14a65e1b93.gif[/img]

In the garage itself, the player has several repair options. The player will be able to unlock more possibilities as the building develops. The first repair I will present here is the replacement of a tire:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/fcb9671f855baaf66514faa43ffaa485a5cbc90b.gif[/img]

At the next level is to replace the windshield

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/0f7eca018862312dfab1bbbe61854d529ee9c3a4.gif[/img]

And at the last level of garage development we get a car lift with which we will be able to change the oil in the car.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/bbb8b22dc393f501a46048d7f8225de41c9b54ee.gif[/img]

In addition, I would like to introduce you to Frank! - This is a friend of the previous owner of the farm, he will help us in future tasks and acclimatize to the farm 😄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/341c543f1d5f4bfb22190e939d93ec57fe9f18dd.png[/img]

That's all in this devlog. Don't forget to visit our discord and until next time! 😄

[url=https://discord.gg/PHvSuTAFKv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/3a33d7a961edb8bfedd0091accdb1ae0e4a04007.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: DEVLOG#8
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Farm renovator devlog !😄[/h1]

In this devlog I'd like to show you the next progress of the work.
Let's start with the fact that we have a game menu! In the following screenshot you can see how it looks :) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/4fd704d43af04d99607076b19a07ee9d5cec660b.png[/img]

We have introduced the first player assists in the form of tutorials. When a player does an action for the first time, he will receive a description of it at the bottom of the screen and an explanation of which buttons to use :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/bfe9a14dfc0d4166bc4b313c0b2d84524884b5d6.png[/img]

Quest markers in the game world have also been added. When a player receives a quest to complete it will be visible as an exclamation mark in the game world :D 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/dad163de0147bf1ac196bde7fe5577235b1d4068.png[/img]

From now on we will also display a list of quests on the right side of the screen and a percentage progress bar for completed activities, we can see this in the gif below: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/0c963495921955931dd97cdbc90e2e6c59328fc8.gif[/img]

Also, slowly more and more sounds are appearing in the game. You can see a sample of the initial sounds in the video below (they may change as the game develops):

[previewyoutube=i3FEitXErGU;full][/previewyoutube]


That's all in this devlog. Don't forget to visit our discord and until next time! 😄

[url=https://discord.gg/PHvSuTAFKv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/3a33d7a961edb8bfedd0091accdb1ae0e4a04007.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: DEVLOG#7
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Farm renovator devlog 😄[/h1]

In today's devlog I'd like to show you more progress on the work.
Let's start with a new machine - the Table Saw. The player, in the course of his journey on the map, will from time to time find fallen trees.
If he decides to cut them into pieces he will gain logs of wood, which after using on the table saw - will turn into a free source of boards! 😄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/ee84f6f9603ccaf04b19dcbfe138ac5a3ce6bb61.gif[/img]

Another mechanic is collecting eggs :). As we learned from previous devlogs, the player will have the opportunity to raise animals among others - hens.
Hens, in addition to earning money by selling them, will give us eggs, which as a player we will be able to find mainly around the hen house 😄
Collected eggs we will be able to put on the shelf in the store and sell which will help us to get additional income.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/f168ef5f152b17c66ef68b24343d430df5cc3d39.gif[/img]

As we are already at the animals it is worth saying about the cowshed. We will keep larger animals there. But we will also have to clean up after them. 
With the help of cleaning comes new tools: Forks and wheelbarrows. With them, we will be able to scoop animal droppings into wheelbarrows and haul them away for manure.
This will give us natural fertilizer for our plants after time, which will translate into better crops 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/8db65cdf65a2a2ad12108b08ede1f3fdfc169c40.gif[/img]

The player has more and more tools, and slowly begins to run out of space for them in the carrying inventory, so we have added a wall of tools to the game.
On the wall we will be able to leave equipment that we don't happen to use for a particular job, and we will be able to carry only the necessary tools with us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/d0c5c28a7050d1167f4c33d4fce30a4f2107bb06.gif[/img]

Also changed the barn - as you can see it is ready for the future renovator 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/6795c7b6ffec80edb17686b22a7d3e720e299b5d.gif[/img]

The last thing we added is the ability to go to bed.
If our ordered products do not arrive until the next day, we can speed up the time and take a nap 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/e1b570819ce5ea5545245961207484d66f66df73.gif[/img]


That's all in this devlog, don't forget to check out our discord! We'll see you in the next devlog 😄

[url=https://discord.gg/PHvSuTAFKv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/3a33d7a961edb8bfedd0091accdb1ae0e4a04007.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: DEVLOG#4
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Farm renovator devlog 😄.[/h1]

Let's start with the newest tool - the chainsaw, which will be useful for removing fallen trees and cutting down damaged elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/df4b3d4829cd9d0167013aef3c9ef3ae5f4cc144.gif[/img]

After cutting the trees, we get wooden logs - believe me, they will be very useful : )

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/7bfe074102ce9ce51b5689afe14a53e29fd1b2ce.gif[/img]

What would a farm be without animals? We added a cow, pigs and chickens for starters, just look at these beauties 😄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/014feb02291e0381e10932df3f5ec02c050c9e4e.gif[/img]

Not everything can be found on the farm. Sometimes we need to order something. In this situation, uncle simon's transport company comes to our rescue 😄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/3e367ffe280f3292a34d213da83e01c62c592d51.gif[/img]

Finally, I have left the best for last - cleaning! I present to you beautifully dilapidated and cluttered rooms that are already waiting for you to clean and renovate 😄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/4be742f07ed30923aa42603c415d28979d1b3c0f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/34a7fd7347eb8a11d577901c4cbd7fc687935c6e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/f443c43c88f2158dc8338b7414ade307d1a4f93b.gif[/img]

That's all in this devlog, don't forget to check out our discord! We'll see you in the next devlog 😄

[url=https://discord.gg/PHvSuTAFKv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/3a33d7a961edb8bfedd0091accdb1ae0e4a04007.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: DEVLOG#3
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Farm renovator devlog 😀.[/h1]

I know you couldn't wait to find out what's new on our farm, without further ado I invite you to review the new features! 😀

To begin with - if you thought that vegetation will grow only around the farm you were wrong, the entire map on which the player will move will have lush and dense vegetation : )

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/d236930676e1c3ed4a9ce00602401ece87430384.gif[/img]

And what if our yard becomes overgrown with grass? All is not lost yet, our intrepid lawnmower will cut it all :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/ddc13692fa61a56fac6e7469a6f7fd9297af5cb2.gif[/img]

However, if you prefer to rely on the strength of your own muscles, we have a tool designed specifically for you - the scythe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/1417aff2cce4bcdffc79d03c2e358e88a119141d.gif[/img]

The farm will have its own store where we can sell our crops. However, before we can start selling in the store, we need to restore it to working order. One of the steps will be to repair the store shelves - how do you like it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/300028bbe7bbd7ee6e25b242b7bc9de29e1c4ee0.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/078f2bc6e94ce2b3410912eed13f5344b3d7a5aa.gif[/img]

That's all in this devlog, don't forget to visit our discord where we share interesting facts and funny situations from game development. See you in the next devlog !

[url=https://discord.gg/PHvSuTAFKv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/3a33d7a961edb8bfedd0091accdb1ae0e4a04007.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: DEVLOG#2
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to another devlog from Farm Renovator![/h2]

For all of you who are tired from a week at work - a handful of new information from events on the farm!

Let's get to know the place where our neighbor, the crazy oldman, lives. He is a man who will mainly help us with agricultural issues but has quite controversial views. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/8ec070246ccc5d93b6ec5cda49cfeef7d54c5a9c.gif[/img]

On the other side of the farm we see an abandoned house on the lake, let's hope that someone will move there, since it's a beautiful piece of land after all : )

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/d937af7c44481c46ad250f7f09bd6a6aa8b6eb98.gif[/img]

In this devlog we present an indispensable and one of the most important items for working at height - the Ladder, without it roof repair would be extremely difficult.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/30a98355d1755538d31688c199b707cab46a5ca3.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/57ef670959ab4089bc5dae4b7764f7c1d80ec72d.gif[/img]

If we need to transport something, our pickup truck will be perfect for this - it will take us to every corner of the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/e5e08a5b4fc2889035419c55bf6bc7d5176d055d.gif[/img]

And finally the most important - a new model of hammer for more precise work : )

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41856515/d09eb6e91c5e80dea2096df2b16a44a3b402265e.gif[/img]

That's all in this devlog. See you there and stay tuned for more updates from our farm!
